name: Image2GPT
tagline: Independent AI image generator and editor (not affiliated with OpenAI)
description: Image2GPT is an independent AI image generation and editing platform at images2gpt.com. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by OpenAI, even though people also search for it as GPT Image 2 or ChatGPT Image 2. You can start from a text prompt, a reference photo, or both, then edit in plain language — including inpainting, outpainting, background replacement, and object removal without masks or layers. A character/subject lock can reuse a face or object across a series. Official typography copy claims high spelling accuracy for logos, posters, and packaging. Default output is crisp 2K, with 4K upscaling listed on paid plans. Generation currently requires a paid plan; the FAQ says there is no free credit grant. The smallest listed pack is a one-time $4.90 for 50 credits (about five 1K images, no subscription). Paid plans include commercial rights. Watermark-free exports are listed as a paid-plan feature.
